units.source_text: 这言谈纯真而坦率，很有余韵。

en.t: This way of speaking was innocent and frank, and it left a deep aftertaste.

units.source_text: 这是天真地倾吐情感的声音。

en.t: It was the voice of someone innocently pouring out her feelings.

units.source_text: 连我也朴实地感觉到自己是个好人。

en.t: Even I simply felt that I was a good person.

units.source_text: 我心情舒畅，抬眼望了望明亮的群山。

en.t: My spirits lifted, and I raised my eyes to look at the bright mountains.

units.source_text: 我已经二十岁了，再三严格自省，自己的性格被孤儿的气质扭曲了。

en.t: I was already twenty, and after examining myself severely again and again, I saw that my character had been warped by the temperament of an orphan.

units.source_text: 我忍受不了那种令人窒息的忧郁，才到伊豆来旅行的。

en.t: Unable to endure that suffocating melancholy, I had come traveling to Izu.

units.source_text: 因此，有人根据社会上的一般看法，认为我是个好人，我真是感激不尽。

en.t: So when someone judged me by ordinary social standards and thought I was a good person, I was truly grateful beyond words.

units.source_text: 山峦明亮起来，已经快到下田海滨了。

en.t: The mountain ranges grew bright, and we were already nearing the seashore at Shimoda.

units.source_text: 我挥动着刚才那根竹子，斩断了不少秋草尖。

en.t: I swung the bamboo stick from before and cut off many tips of autumn grasses.
